english.title: Attempt to indecently assault on a girl under the age of 16 years
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to indecently assault **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), a girl under the age of 16 years
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(1) of, and Schedule 2 to, the Sexual Offences Act 1956 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempted to indecently assault
a girl under the age of 16

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS OBSOLETE - Legislation repealed.

(i) See also offence wordings: H533 and H534 for offences relating to victims over 16 years and under 14 years of age.
(ii) This offence is included in Schedule 1 to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person convicted or cautioned for this offence must comply with the requirements of section 2 of that Act.
(iii) This offence is included in Schedule 2 to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person committing this offence outside the United Kingdom may in certain circumstances be prosecuted for that offence in England, Wales or Northern Ireland.
(iv) See Sexual Offences (Conspiracy and Incitement) Act 1996 for incitement to commit offences outside the United Kingdom where the victim is under 16 years old. This Act came into force on 1.10.96 and relates to acts or events occurring on or after that date.
(v) The anonymity of the victim applies. Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 1992.
(vi) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003
(vii) For historic offences of indecently assaulting a girl under the age of 16 please see R v J [2004] UKHL 42.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
